id: 06_Replace the Safety Relay for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊机安全继电器的更换（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/06_Replace the Safety Relay for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/06_Replace the Safety Relay for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder（国内版）/src.py

points.S1: 谁能修：专业人员，先报修

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台打开侧板的焊机主机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a handheld laser welder unit with its side panel open and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：焊机里的安全继电器怎么换。
overlay: 激光焊机安全继电器的更换

shots.scene: 黄色继电器图标连着急停按钮和锁形联锁图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellow relay module icon linked by lines to a red emergency stop button icon and a padlock interlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它管着急停和联锁，是安全的关键。

shots.scene: 焊机屏幕上报警灯亮，阿杰拿起螺丝刀想自己拆
shots.prompt_en: A warning light glows on the welder touchscreen; the young male student picks up a screwdriver, ready to open the machine himself.
shots.narration: 焊机报安全回路故障，阿杰想自己拆。

shots.scene: 王老师拦住阿杰，指向墙上的报修电话
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops the young male student and points to a blank repair request poster with a phone icon on the wall.
shots.narration: 王老师拦住他：内部维修不能自己来。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱走来，胸前挂着空白证件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives carrying a toolbox, a blank certificate badge on his chest.
shots.narration: 报修后，由专业的老李来处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们看看专业人员是怎么做的。

shots.scene: 主机内部示意，黄色继电器模块被圈出
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of the welder unit interior with the yellow safety relay module circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 要换的，是主机里的安全继电器。

shots.scene: 黄黑警示卡，上面是高压和激光两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellow and black hazard banner with a high voltage icon and a laser warning icon, no text. No people.
shots.narration: 机内有高压和强激光。

shots.scene: 非专业人员拆机的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an untrained person opening a machine with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只限专业人员，严禁擅自拆机。

shots.scene: 电源图标和钟表，提示残余高压
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a laser power supply box with a lightning bolt and a clock, showing waiting time. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后电源里还可能有高压，要等。

shots.scene: 老李戴上绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated electrical gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工具摆在台上：两把十字螺丝刀、一把一字螺丝刀、扎带、剪刀、新继电器
shots.prompt_en: On a bench: two Phillips screwdrivers of different sizes, a small flathead screwdriver, cable ties, scissors and a new yellow relay module in its box. No people.
shots.narration: 备好螺丝刀、扎带、剪刀和新继电器。

shots.scene: 主机背面所有线缆都已拔下
shots.prompt_en: The back of the welder unit with every cable and hose unplugged and coiled aside. No people.
shots.narration: 先确认所有连接都已断开。

shots.scene: 脚踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a foot pressing down a caster brake on the welder unit.
shots.narration: 锁住四个脚轮。

shots.scene: 主机旁一个钟表图标，指针转动
shots.prompt_en: The welder unit stands still beside a large clock icon whose hand sweeps around. No people.
shots.narration: 静置一段时间，放电、冷却。

shots.scene: 老李打开主机左侧板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in insulated gloves opens the left side panel of the welder unit.
shots.narration: 打开左侧板。

shots.scene: 老李用十字螺丝刀拧下送丝机面板四周的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws around the wire feeder panel with a Phillips screwdriver.
shots.narration: 拧下送丝机面板的一圈螺丝。

shots.scene: 拆下黄绿接地线的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small screwdriver removing the screw of a green-yellow ground wire on the panel.
shots.narration: 再拆下接地线。

shots.scene: 送丝机面板放倒，露出机内电气部件
shots.prompt_en: The wire feeder panel is laid down, revealing contactors, a yellow relay module and circuit boards inside. No people besides gloved hands.
shots.narration: 把面板放倒，露出内部。

shots.scene: 剪刀剪断两根扎带
shots.prompt_en: Close view of scissors in a gloved hand cutting two cable ties around a wire bundle.
shots.narration: 剪断两根扎带。

shots.scene: 拔下连到主板的线缆插头
shots.prompt_en: Close view of gloved fingers unplugging two cable connectors from a circuit board.
shots.narration: 断开连到主板的线缆。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀拆下接触器上方的四根线
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a screwdriver loosening four wires from the top of a contactor.
shots.narration: 拆下接触器上方的几根线。

shots.scene: 拆下固定组件的螺丝，整体取出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws holding a mounting plate and lifts out the plate with contactors and the yellow relay.
shots.narration: 拧下固定螺丝，取出整个组件。

shots.scene: 取下导轨上的卡扣，继电器滑出
shots.prompt_en: On a bench, gloved hands remove a small clip from a mounting rail and slide the yellow relay module off the rail.
shots.narration: 取下卡扣，把继电器滑出导轨。

shots.scene: 小一字螺丝刀逐根松开继电器端子上的线
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small flathead screwdriver loosening each wire from the terminals of the yellow relay module.
shots.narration: 用小一字刀，拆下全部导线。

shots.scene: 新继电器端子标记与线上标签对照
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a new yellow relay module with blank terminal markers and wire ends with blank tags, matched by dotted lines. No people.
shots.narration: 新继电器接线，线号对准端子标记。

shots.scene: 老李逐根接线拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in insulated gloves inserts each wire into a terminal and tightens it with a small screwdriver.
shots.narration: 一根一根接好、拧紧。

shots.scene: 手指轻拉每根线
shots.prompt_en: Close view of gloved fingers gently tugging each connected wire to check it is firm.
shots.narration: 逐根轻拉，确认没有松动。

shots.scene: 继电器滑入导轨，卡扣压紧后拧螺丝
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands slide the relay back onto the rail, press the clip against it and tighten the clip screw.
shots.narration: 滑回导轨，卡扣压紧固定。

shots.scene: 组件放回机内，拧上固定螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The mounting plate with the contactors and relay is placed back inside the unit and fixed with screws.
shots.narration: 组件放回机内，螺丝拧紧。

shots.scene: 接触器接线与参考图并排对照
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank reference wiring picture and the real contactor terminals, with matching dotted lines. No people.
shots.narration: 接触器的线，线序要和参考图一致。

shots.scene: 线缆插回主板
shots.prompt_en: Close view of gloved fingers plugging two cable connectors back into the circuit board.
shots.narration: 两根线缆插回主板。

shots.scene: 用两根扎带把线束扎好
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands bundle the wires neatly with two new cable ties and trim the ends.
shots.narration: 用扎带把线束扎整齐。

shots.scene: 送丝电机线插回主控板
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a motor cable being plugged into the main control board.
shots.narration: 送丝电机线插回主控板。

shots.scene: 接回接地线，装回送丝机面板
shots.prompt_en: The green-yellow ground wire is screwed back on and the wire feeder panel is lifted into place and fixed with screws.
shots.narration: 接回接地线，装好面板。

shots.scene: 合上左侧板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the left side panel of the welder unit.
shots.narration: 合上左侧板。

shots.section_title: 谁能修：专业人员，先报修
shots.scene: 学生拆机的图标打叉，旁边报修单
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a student opening a machine crossed out with a red X, next to a blank repair request form. No people.
shots.narration: 设备内部故障，学生不能自己拆。
overlay: 谁能修：专业人员，先报修

shots.section_title: 谁能修：专业人员，先报修
shots.scene: 王老师在空白报修单上签字，交给老李
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank repair request form and hands it to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 先报修，由厂家或持证人员维修。

shots.scene: 配电箱断路器拉下，上锁挂空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A circuit breaker for the welder is switched off, locked with a padlock and tagged with a blank warning tag. No people.
shots.narration: 维修前断电、上锁、挂牌。

shots.scene: 老李用验电笔检查端子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in insulated gloves checks the terminals inside the unit with a voltage tester.
shots.narration: 动手前先验电，确认无电。

shots.scene: 主机上挂着维修中、禁止使用的空白牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank sign with a wrench icon and a no-entry icon hangs on the welder unit. No people.
shots.narration: 挂维修牌，别人不能开机。

shots.scene: 短接线绕过继电器的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a wire jumper bypassing the yellow relay module, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全回路绝不能短接。

shots.scene: 原厂备件盒打勾，杂牌件打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a sealed original spare part box with a green check, and an unknown loose part with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用原厂备件，不能乱换型号。

shots.scene: 修好后按下急停，屏幕显示停止
shots.prompt_en: After repair, the facility engineer presses the emergency stop button and the touchscreen shows a stop icon.
shots.narration: 修完先测急停是否有效。

shots.scene: 断开联锁，屏幕出光被禁止
shots.prompt_en: The interlock loop is opened and the touchscreen shows the laser enable blocked with a lock icon. No people besides a hand.
shots.narration: 再测联锁：断开时不能出光。

shots.scene: 三项测试全部打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with three items, an emergency stop icon, a lock icon and a laser icon, all ticked green. No people.
shots.narration: 全部正常，才能恢复使用。

shots.scene: 老李在空白维修记录本上填写
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes in a blank repair logbook next to the welder.
shots.narration: 写清故障、更换部件和测试结果。

shots.scene: 王老师验收后取下维修牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the logbook and removes the repair sign from the welder.
shots.narration: 验收合格，再摘下维修牌。

shots.scene: 示意：有人触电，旁人先拉下电闸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person collapses beside a machine; another person switches off the main breaker first instead of touching him. No people besides simple figures.
shots.narration: 有人触电，先断电，别直接拉人。

shots.scene: 小研拨打电话，显示120，旁边报告图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call showing 120; icons of a lab door, a college building and a security shield appear beside her.
shots.narration: 拨打120，并逐级报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现报修单、锁、验电笔图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of a repair form, a padlock and a voltage tester.
shots.narration: 先报修，断电验电，专业人员来修。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现线号、参考图、拉线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a wire tag, a reference picture and a hand tugging a wire.
shots.narration: 线号对端子，线序对参考图。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现急停、联锁、记录本图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of an emergency stop button, an interlock lock and a logbook.
shots.narration: 修后测急停联锁，记录验收。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老李、王老师、阿杰在焊机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the safety administrator and the young male student wave goodbye beside the repaired welder.
shots.narration: 安全器件靠专业，下次见！
